column3: NKJV has “both of the Father and of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “of God, namely Christ.”
NKJV includes “of the sins,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
Close to the Greek; NKJV has “forgiven you” with the Textus Receptus, while the critical text reads “forgiven us.”
NKJV has “those things which he has not seen,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the things he has seen.”
